crystal.title: Crystal structure
crystal.displayAtoms: {{count}} displayed atoms. Periodic copies are never saved.
crystal.readOnlyHost: Read-only preview. The host has not enabled editing.
crystal.conflict: The source changed while you were editing. Saving is blocked. Save a copy to keep your edits, then reset to reload the source.
crystal.saveError: Could not save. Your edits are retained: {{error}}
crystal.latticeHint: Lattice edits keep fractional coordinates fixed. Press Enter or leave a field to apply it.
crystal.webglUnavailable: 3D preview needs WebGL. The atom table and supported editing remain available.

issues.tooLarge: This structure exceeds the preview limits (2 million characters, 150,000 CIF tokens or 5,000 source atoms). No truncated structure will be saved.
issues.unsupportedFormat: Supported crystal files: POSCAR, CONTCAR, .vasp and simple .cif.
issues.invalidNumber: Enter a finite numeric value within the supported range.
issues.invalidLattice: The lattice is missing, singular or outside the supported range. Cell lengths must be positive and angles must define a nonzero volume.
issues.invalidPoscar: Invalid or unsupported POSCAR. A single scale, explicit species, counts and Direct/Cartesian coordinates are required.
issues.missingSpecies: Element identities are missing or unsupported. VASP 4 files without a species line cannot be edited safely.
issues.invalidCif: This CIF syntax is invalid or outside the supported simple-CIF subset. Open the original source to inspect it.
issues.missingCell: The CIF does not provide all six lattice parameters. No lattice was inferred.
issues.missingAtoms: No complete fractional or Cartesian atom-site loop was found.
issues.readOnly: This structure cannot be saved through the supported editor.
issues.invalidEdit: This edit cannot be represented safely in the source format.
issues.displayLimit: Periodic copies exceed the limit of 12,000 displayed atoms.
issues.multipleBlocks: Read-only: this CIF has multiple data blocks. Only source sites in the first block are previewed; a saved copy retains the entire original file.
issues.unknownSymmetry: Read-only: P1 symmetry is not explicitly established or nonidentity symmetry is present. Only source sites are shown; symmetry mates are not generated.
issues.partialOccupancy: Read-only: partial or zero occupancy is present. Shown sites are not a fully occupied crystal model.
issues.unknownOccupancy: Read-only: a site occupancy is explicitly unknown. It has not been replaced with 1.
issues.unspecifiedOccupancy: Some site occupancies are unspecified. The editor preserves their omission and does not insert occupancy values.
issues.unsupportedCif: Read-only: additional CIF semantics are present, such as displacement parameters, extra coordinate sets or unsupported tags. Editing could make those values inconsistent.
issues.uncertainty: Read-only: this CIF contains measurement uncertainties. Editing requires a crystallographic editor that preserves their meaning.
issues.poscarTail: Read-only: additional POSCAR sections follow the positions (for example velocities). They are retained in an exported copy.
